summary: Report quality gate execution accurately and fail closed on unavailable checks

delivery.outcome: MCP and CLI gate reports fail closed on missing tools, execution errors and unknown gates, and show executed argv. Publish through protected validation.
nonGoals: Do not replace absolute Regix gates with delta checks or relax quality thresholds
Do not change c2004 source, tickets or policy

architecture.decision: Keep existing gate selection and absolute Regix command; treat every unsuccessful executed check as failed and attach argv to its result. Preserve the existing explicit TestQL no-scenarios skip.
interfaceChanges: Add command argv to executed gate result payloads

validation.evidence: Real subprocess failures and isolated gate aggregation regression tests.
